subject: Kestrel Systems — pilot handshake & kickoff actions
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@kestrelsys.com>, Priya Reddy <priya@kestrelsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kestrel discovery recap + proposed pilot scope

Hi Oliver / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed light-weight POC to validate fit. Please skim and tell me what to adjust.

Key pain you described:
- High rate of misrouted tickets and manual triage — ~22% false positives on auto-routing currently.
- Latency expectations for triage must stay under 200ms median for customer-facing flows.
- Strict data residency and auditability for any logs processed in the pilot.

Goals for the POC (what success looks like):
1) Improve auto-routing precision by 10–15% vs current baseline on your sampled dataset.
2) Demonstrate stable p95 latency under 250ms for 99% of test requests in our sandbox.
3) Export audit logs and a simple quality dashboard for stakeholder review.

Proposed pilot scope (2-week active eval + 2-week monitoring):
- Dataset: 3k representative tickets (anonymized) from your support queue (we'll walk through scrub checklist).
- Prompt set: initial 40 prompts covering common intents + edge cases (we'll send prompt matrix).
- Eval: weekly accuracy/precision report + latency summary; final handoff with prompt-eval artifact.
- Owners: Ben Carter (sales, pilot owner), Monica Patel (CS, success manager), Marcus Lin (inference engineer).

Immediate asks from Kestrel to start:
- S3 read access to the anonymized dataset (time-limited IAM role) OR secure upload link.
- Confirmation of a single security contact to expedite the short SOC/compliance checklist.
- Target kickoff week: Feb 23rd (flexible if you need a later start).

I attached a short pilot-scope doc and an access checklist CSV to make provisioning simpler. If Feb 23 works, I’ll loop Marcus in to provision a sandbox and share a small onboarding runbook.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm dataset delivery method and security contact.
2) We sign an SOW-lite (scope + duration) — I’ll draft a one-pager once you confirm the scope above.
3) Kickoff prep call with Marcus & Monica to walk access and eval criteria (30 min).

Thanks — looking forward to moving fast.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: kestrel-pilot-scope-v1.pdf (15 KB)
Attachment: access-checklist.csv (2 KB)
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@kestrelsys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@kestrelsys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel discovery recap + proposed pilot scope

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 3k ticket sample is fine; we'll anonymize and push to an S3 bucket in your region. I can give you the upload instructions once we confirm the IAM approach.
- Security contact: Priya Reddy (cc’d) will lead our internal review and coordinate SOC checklist items. She may ask for a brief call with your security team — that’s fine.
- Timeline: Feb 23 start is tight for our security team. Can we aim Feb 25 for kickoff so Priya has two extra days to gather internal approvals?

Also: We have one non-negotiable requirement — all pilot logs must be retained in our tenant for audit and must not be used outside the engagement (NDA already covers this; you mentioned a retention flag in the sandbox). Please include that as a configuration step in the onboarding runbook.

If you can update the one-pager to reflect Feb 25 start and the retention requirement, we’re good to sign off and upload the dataset.

—Oliver
Oliver Hayes
Head of Product | Kestrel Systems
oliver.hayes@kestrelsys.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver.hayes@kestrelsys.com>, Priya Reddy <priya@kestrelsys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel discovery recap + proposed pilot scope — updated kickoff plan and onboarding actions

Great — thanks for the quick reply and the retention constraint, Oliver. I updated the plan below to reflect the Feb 25 kickoff and the log retention requirement. Marcus and Monica are looped for the technical onboarding.

Pilot kickoff (updated) — week of Feb 25
- Active phase: Feb 25 — Mar 10 (2 full weeks + buffer)
- Monitoring: Mar 11 — Mar 25 (observability & handoff)

Success metrics (concrete checkpoints):
- Model precision lift: +12% on ticket routing by end of active phase (measured on held-out 600-ticket test set).
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for the inference API for 95% of calls during load testing (we'll run a scripted 10-minute ramp at target QPS).
- Audit: daily log export to your tenant; retention flag set to 90 days in sandbox (configurable).

Prompt/eval plan:
- Initial prompt matrix: 40 prompts (dev), expanded to 120 prompts for final eval.
- Weekly prompt-eval report (precision/recall + qualitative edge-case notes).

Onboarding & access checklist (action items):
1) Kestrel: Create S3 bucket or grant a temp IAM role scoped to the bucket; provide ARN and point of contact (Priya).
2) Kestrel: Share a short sample (100 anonymized tickets) by Feb 23 so Marcus can validate formatting.
3) Redwood: Provision sandbox w/ tenant-bound logs and retention flag; Marcus will confirm credentials and endpoint.
4) Both: Quick security sync (15–20m) between Priya and our security lead to close checklist items.

Marcus: can you provision the sandbox and send onboarding credentials by Feb 24 EOD? If you need any additional info from Kestrel, tell us what to request (IAM role, sample file name, encryption details).

Priya / Oliver: once Marcus confirms the credential approach I’ll send the SOW-lite (one-pager) and a DocuSign link to get scope approval signed.

Thanks — I’ll attach the updated one-pager and re-send the access-checklist as CSV.

Best,
Ben

Attachment: kestrel-pilot-scope-v1.pdf (updated)
Attachment: access-checklist.csv

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Action: sandbox provisioning + upload guidance for Kestrel (KD-2026-0047)

Marcus / Monica —

Looping you both for operational handoff. Quick asks below (Kestrel is ready to provide a 100-ticket sample by Feb 23 and wants kickoff Feb 25):

What we need from infra (Marcus):
- Provision a tenant-isolated sandbox with the following:
  * Endpoint: inference endpoint reachable over TLS; API key rotation support.
  * Log retention: tenant-bound, 90-day retention flag set by default.
  * Access method: short-lived IAM role (recommend STS) scoped to a redwood-inference S3 upload bucket.
- Send onboarding credentials + small runbook to Kestrel contact (Priya) by Feb 24 EOD.
- Note any security artifacts Priya will ask for (we expect SOC questionnaire items for this engagement).

Monica — can you own the kickoff call on Feb 25 and run through success criteria and weekly eval cadence? I’ll join as well for the first call.

Oliver / Priya — appreciate the patience on timing. Marcus will confirm the credential approach by tomorrow. If you have any constraints on encryption or a particular upload pattern (multipart, presigned URL), note them now.
